fusions.name: Ballast Heave
fusions.desc: Heaves a ballast weight that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Broadside
fusions.desc: Looses 3 heavy weights at once, spread apart, each dealing 13 damage and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Full Canvas
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Swell Rider
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
